convention: sourceFen/original.FEN is BEFORE setupMove; solverFen is AFTER setupMove; solution excludes setup and includes alternating solver/opponent plies

selection.deduplication: first in selection order per band per normalized solver position (FEN first four fields, legal en passant); clocks ignored
selection.ordering: per band, round-robin over themes ordered by ascending eligible frequency then theme name; within a theme ascending SHA256(UTF-8(seed:band_id:PuzzleId))
selection.scope: complete official CSV; every eligible row is considered

serialization: UTF-8, LF; JSONL sorted keys compact separators; JSON sorted keys indent=2 trailing LF

source_snapshot.limitations: the 307 MB compressed archive is not retained; verify needs the same archive (checked by archive_sha256). The URL is mutable, so a fresh download need not reproduce it.
